name: Zion & Bryce Canyon
about: Spring (Mar–May) and fall (Sep–Oct) are the sweet spot, Zion's canyon floor is scorching by midsummer, and Bryce's high rim gets real winter snow.
overview: Two of Utah's most dramatic national parks — Zion's soaring red sandstone canyon and Bryce's otherworldly hoodoos — a scenic drive apart.
costOverview: Each park charges its own entrance fee — and starting in 2026, non-US residents pay a real, separate surcharge on top of the standard pass.

specialSeasons.text: Summer monsoon storms bring real flash-flood risk in Zion's slot canyons, including the Narrows — check conditions before wading in.
